stderr: "claim":"One derivation takes ممنون from a giver reminding the recipient of a favor, which causes hurt; here it means a reward free of reproach, as in the warning against reminders after charity.","anchor":"و ( ممنون يجوز أن يكون مشتقا من من المعطي على المعطى إذا عد عليه عطاءه وذكره له ، أو افتخر عليه به","mentions":["2:264"]},{"verses":["68:3"],"words":["غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"النابغة","stance":"reports","claim":"The poet al-Nābighah describes a favor to ʿAmr’s father as having no sting, illustrating the sense of a gift untainted by reproach.","anchor":"قال النابغة : علي لعمرو نعمة بعد نعمة لوالده ليست بذاتت عقارب","mentions":[]},{"verses":["68:3"],"words":["غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ"],"type":"reports","speaker":"عبد الله بن الزبير أو غيره","stance":"reports","claim":"A poem attributed to ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr or another poet praises ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Ashdaq for gifts that were never reproached to their recipients.","anchor":"وقد انتزع من هذه الآية عبد الله بن الزبير ( بكسر الموحدة ) أو غيره في قوله : أيادي لم تمنن وإن هي جلت","mentions":[]},{"verses":["68:3"],"words":["غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"author","stance":"reports","claim":"Alternatively, ممنون derives from cutting a rope: the reward is uncut, continually increasing each day or eternal in the afterlife; the word gathers both senses, unlike عطاء غير مجذوذ in 11:108, fitting this honor to the Prophet.","anchor":"ويجوز أن يكون ( ممنون مشتقا من قولهم : من الحبل ، إذا قطعه ، أي أجرا غير مقطوع عنك","mentions":["11:108"]},{"verses":["68:4"],"words":["خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"After the promise, God refutes the enemies again by confirming the Prophet’s tremendous character, the opposite of madness, with three emphases matching the previous sentence’s emphasis.","anchor":"وبعد أن آنس نفس رسوله بالوعد عاد إلى تسفيه قول الأعداء فحقق أنه متلبس بخلق عظيم","mentions":[]},{"verses":["68:4"],"words":["خُلُقٍ"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"خلق means the soul’s disposition and, when unqualified, is most often used for good character.","anchor":"والخلق : طباع النفس ، وأكثر إطلاقه على طباع الخير إذا لم يتبع بنعت","mentions":["26:137"]},{"verses":["68:4"],"words":["عَظِيمٍ"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"عظيم means high in rank, metaphorically borrowed from bodily bulk so commonly that the figurative use became nearly equivalent to the literal one.","anchor":"والعظيم : الرفيع القدر وهو مستعار من ضخامة الجسم ، وشاعت هذه الاستعارة حتى ساوت الحقيقة","mentions":[]},{"verses":["68:4"],"words":["عَلَىٰ"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"على expresses metaphorical elevation in the sense of firm establishment, as in the cited descriptions of being upon guidance, truth, or a straight path.","anchor":"و ( على ) للاستعلاء المجازي المراد به التمكن كقوله : أولئك على هدى من ربهم } ( البقرة : 5 )","mentions":["2:5","27:79","43:43","22:67"]}]}
